steps.cap: An AI chip is built from several parts. First comes the package base, a layered board that connects everything to the circuit board below.
On it sits an interposer, a thin layer of very fine wiring that joins everything placed on top.
Two logic chips go in the middle. They do the calculating, and each is as large as a chipmaking machine can print.
Eight stacks of memory go beside them, a few millimeters away. They hold the AI model’s weights and the record of each conversation so far.
Together they make one AI accelerator. Most are put together by TSMC, in Taiwan.
